name: services/crstests/change_task_node_permissions
description:
Changes permissions in a TaskNode.

For each pair (user_id, perms) present in the set parameter this method will set permissions of user with ID = user_id to perms.

For each pair (user_id, perms) present in th remove_from_subtree parameter this method will remove all permissions in the perms list for user with ID = user_id in the subtree of referenced node.

arguments.name: set
arguments.description: Dictionary mapping from user ID to lists of PermissionsObjects

arguments.name: remove_from_subtree
arguments.description: Dictionary mapping from user ID to lists of PermissionsObjects

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Currently, this method always returns the same value: a dictionary with single success key with value of true.
